If you’re planning to experience it in 2026, there’s something you need to know right now:

Why Are Inca Trail Permits Limited?

Access to the trail is strictly regulated to protect the historical heritage and fragile Andean ecosystem.

Only a limited number of people can enter each day — including hikers, guides, and porters.

This means the actual number of tourist spots available is much smaller than most people expect.

During high season (May through September), permits often sell out 4 to 6 months in advance.

If you’re planning to travel during these months, securing your spot early is essential.
What Makes the Inca Trail So Special?

4

The Inca Trail is not just a hike.

It’s a once-in-a-lifetime experience that combines:

  • Exclusive Inca archaeological sites not accessible by other routes
  • Stunning Andean mountain landscapes
  • The famous Warmiwañusca Pass (Dead Woman’s Pass)
  • Cloud forests rich in biodiversity
  • Arrival at Machu Picchu through the Sun Gate (Inti Punku) at sunrise

That entrance is simply unforgettable.
No other route offers this moment.

How to Book the Inca Trail 2026 Properly

It’s important to know that permits cannot be purchased independently.

Only licensed tour operators authorized by the Peruvian government can officially secure your entry.

The booking process is simple when handled correctly:

1 Send a clear copy of your valid passport
2 Confirm availability for your preferred date
3 Secure your permit through official registration
4 Receive formal confirmation of your spot

Your passport must match exactly the document you will carry during the trek.

Is the Inca Trail Difficult?

The difficulty level is moderate to challenging due to altitude.

  • Maximum elevation above 4,000 meters (13,000+ ft)
  • Several hours of hiking per day
  • Requires good physical condition

We strongly recommend arriving in Cusco at least 2 days before the trek to acclimatize properly.

With the right preparation, the experience is absolutely achievable and deeply rewarding.

What Happens If I Wait Too Long?

In many cases:

  • The most requested dates disappear quickly
  • Travelers must change their travel plans
  • Or settle for alternative trekking routes

If hiking the Classic Inca Trail is your dream, the best decision is to secure your permit early.

It’s a life-changing journey.

That’s why we help you:

Our team supports you from booking day until you reach Machu Picchu.
